summary: First test run of Quotation Generator (Expo + FastAPI mirror). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass covering health, categories, requester/admin auth, catalog CRUD, CSV import, and money-config auto-provisioning + updates. Wrong admin credentials correctly return 401 with envelope. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): full requester flow works — role select → register → catalog with category chips + items → Add → View Draft FAB → edit qty/price with live subtotal/discount/GST/grand-total updates → Generate Quotation renders formatted plain-text output. Full admin flow works — role select → login screen with link → register (Company/GSTIN/Contact/Passcode) → dashboard with stat cards → Manage Catalog (add with category picker, appears in list, action modal Edit/Delete, delete works) → Money Configuration (edit discount/GST %, toggle switches, save shows success) → CSV Import page renders with pick-csv-btn. Session persistence verified: reload after sign-in lands on dashboard, not role selection. Sign out returns to role selection. Only minor issue: console warnings about deprecated `shadow*` style props (React Native new architecture wants `boxShadow`).

issues: Category chip row scrolls horizontally and cuts off last chip at the right edge (e.g., 'Materials'). Works as designed but consider a subtle fade/indicator so users know to scroll.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated `shadow*` style props are used; React Native web logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.'. Migrate to the `boxShadow` style / equivalent RN shadow props to silence warnings and be forward-compatible.

action_items: Optional: migrate `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` (RN new architecture) in src/theme.ts and src/components/UI.tsx to remove deprecation warnings.
Optional UX polish: add a fade/scroll indicator on the horizontal category chip row so users notice more chips exist off-screen.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly uses `strip_mongo` / `{_id: 0}` projections everywhere — no ObjectId leaks.
Admin passcodes are bcrypt-hashed on register and verified on login. Duplicate contactNumber returns 400.
Envelope `{success,data,error}` is consistent across all endpoints including error paths (401/400/404).
Money config auto-provision on GET is idempotent and uses upsert on PUT — good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via src/config/env.ts; all interactive elements have testID; text is wrapped in <Text> components.
seed_data_creation: Test-only data was created via API: a TEST_UI_Co admin (contact was random 87XXXXXXXX, passcode adm1n$ecret — logged only during test run), a requester (Test User), several TEST_CSV_* catalog items and a TEST_Cat_* category. All prefixed with TEST_ for easy cleanup. Nothing production-relevant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://quotation-expo.preview.emergentagent.com (routes under /api). Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_quotation_api.py covers all endpoints end-to-end and is idempotent (uses uuid-based contact numbers). Frontend testIDs are dense and reliable — see grep list of testID= in /app/frontend/app/**. Role selection is at '/', requester flow lives under (requester), admin under (admin). Session is persisted via zustand+AsyncStorage in src/state/session.ts, so localStorage.clear() + reload resets to role selection when scripting fresh scenarios.
